attribute_types.GeneratedId: ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9-]*; allocated by renderer; author names encoded as n- plus UTF-8 lowercase hex
attribute_types.RegisteredClassList: space-separated names registered in the backend stylesheet; not arbitrary source Text
attribute_types.Text: valid UTF-8 and XML 1.0 Char scalars; reject disallowed scalar with InvalidMarkupCharacter; escape according to doc/spec/13-reproducibility.md
attribute_types.FragmentHref: # plus UTF-8 percent encoding of a decoded HtmlId; preserve only ASCII alphanumeric and -._~; same-fragment target must exist
attribute_types.Decimal: finite base-10 number, no NaN/Infinity/exponent; canonical trailing zeros removed
attribute_types.ViewBox: four Decimal values min-x min-y width height; width/height > 0
attribute_types.Points: nonempty ordered list of pairs of Decimal values
attribute_types.Path: typed Move/Line/Horizontal/Vertical/Close commands with Decimal arguments only
attribute_types.Paint: none or #RRGGBB; no url(), currentColor or arbitrary CSS
attribute_types.DashList: nonempty list of nonnegative Decimal, at least one > 0
attribute_types.NonnegativeMathLength: canonical nonnegative finite decimal followed by em; no sign, exponent, percentage, leading zeros or redundant trailing fractional zeros; zero is 0em
attribute_types.HtmlHref: typed Fragment/Artifact/BetweenArtifacts/External; lexical constraints and structural checks in doc/spec/19-html-fragment.md; source route binding and target availability remain separate preparation obligations
attribute_types.ArtifactPath: nonempty relative ASCII alphanumeric/-_. path; no empty, dot or parent segments; assigned by artifact preparation, not arbitrary author input
attribute_types.HtmlId: Nonempty decoded XML character string excluding U+0000..0020 and U+007F..009F; no Unicode normalization or percent decoding; duplicate ids forbidden

root_slots.HtmlBlock: html flow elements, root math display=block, root svg
root_slots.HtmlPhrasing: validated HTML phrasing including span/a/em/strong/ruby/br/code/img; inline math via its separate profile; no block elements or root svg
root_slots.Math: root math with the required element arities

namespace_transition.html: only root math or root svg starts foreign namespace
namespace_transition.mathml: mtext may contain validated HtmlPhrasing; other elements do not accept arbitrary HTML

trusted_shell: html/head/meta/style/body are emitted by fixed DocumentShell code, not accepted as user Markup nodes; stylesheet body is a fixed backend asset

katex_computed_style.scope: Lexical predicate for current generated Math TeX layout; not HTML admission, full KaTeX CSS, stylesheet extraction or fidelity proof
katex_computed_style.declarations: Empty or semicolon-separated exact lowercase property:value declarations, optional final semicolon; no whitespace, duplicate property, comments, escapes, functions or URLs
katex_computed_style.length: Unitless 0 or optional minus then decimal em; at most 7 integer and 4 fraction digits, magnitude <= 1000000; decimal point requires fraction digits
katex_computed_style.rejection: Reject the entire declaration list; never strip unknown properties and claim faithful rendering; retain original bytes/order for later stylesheet lowering
katex_computed_style.metering: O(n) time, O(1) space, no allocation; charge 4n+1 Work before scanning and preserve sticky stop

katex_path_data.scope: Finite SVG path lexical predicate; not element/viewport/transform validation or geometry/fidelity proof
katex_path_data.commands: Initial M/m required; M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z and lowercase relatives, complete groups with implicit repetition; whitespace is ASCII space, tab, CR or LF
katex_path_data.numbers: Optional sign, decimal with at most 10 integer/16 fraction digits, at least one digit; magnitude <= 1000000000; no exponent
katex_path_data.arcs: SVG 1.1 grammar subset: radii have no sign; large-arc and sweep flags are single 0/1 bytes
katex_path_data.separators: Optional comma/whitespace between parameters, no leading or trailing comma; adjacent signed/dotted numbers and arc flags follow SVG token boundaries
katex_path_data.metering: O(n) time and O(1) space, no allocation; 4n+1 Work before scanning; failure never drops malformed path content

katex_view_box: Exactly four single-space-separated decimal values in katex_path_data number profile; width/height unsigned and strictly positive; no leading/trailing space, commas or other whitespace. 4n+1 Work, O(n) time, O(1) space, no allocation. Does not prove path containment or aspect ratio/fidelity.
html_profile: interfaces/markup.json and doc/spec/19-html-fragment.md define flat Text/Element/MathElement nodes. HTML admits math roots (inline in phrasing, either display in flow); mtext admits checked HTML phrasing. IDs, ancestry and depth cross namespaces. SVG, KaTeX profiles and full artifact preparation remain required, not silently accepted.
